text: Accepted scodec-bits 1.2.4 as an exact direct dependency of kernel, core, and protocol. ADR 0012 records that FS2 3.13.0 already selected this version, so the decision adds direct edges but no new version surface; Vector[Byte] and its boxing/conversion cost was the rejected alternative. This admits ByteVector storage only, not scodec codecs or another protocol.
